name: Netbox
description: Netbox is an IP address management (IPAM) and data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tool. Initially conceived by the network engineering team at DigitalOcean, NetBox was developed specifically to address the needs of network and infrastructure engineers. It is intended to function as a domain-specific source of truth for network operations.
short_desc: Netbox is an IP address management (IPAM) and data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tool
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: ALLOWED_HOST
form_fields.hint: The hostname you will use to access the app (e.g., netbox.example.com)

form_fields.label: BASE_PATH
form_fields.hint: The path you will use to access the app (i.e., /netbox, default: none)

form_fields.label: CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
form_fields.hint: List of comma-separated, single quoted, trusted origins. Must include protocol, and port if applicable (default: [])

form_fields.label: REMOTE_AUTH_BACKEND
form_fields.hint: Python path to the custom Django authentication backend to use for external user authentication (default: netbox.authentication.RemoteUserBackend)

form_fields.label: REMOTE_AUTH_HEADER
form_fields.hint: Name of the HTTP header which informs NetBox of the currently authenticated user. (default: HTTPREMOTEUSER)

form_fields.label: REMOTE_AUTH_AUTO_CREATE_USER
form_fields.hint: If true, NetBox will automatically create local accounts for users authenticated via a remote service (default: False)

form_fields.label: REMOTE_AUTH_DEFAULT_GROUPS
form_fields.hint: The list of groups to assign a new user account when created using remote authentication (default: [])

form_fields.label: REMOTE_AUTH_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS
form_fields.hint: A mapping of permissions to assign a new user account when created using remote authentication (default: {})
